title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
source: Sick Bits Vol. 14 Matrix By Chris Chappell

ai_review.summary: Superb matrix recording of a legendary 9/19/70 show, highlighted by an out‑of‑this‑world Dark Star and seamless St. Stephen → Not Fade Away → Lovelight flow.
ai_review.review: The matrix source captures the concert with exceptional clarity and a spacious “hall” effect that puts listeners right in the venue. Musically the night is dominated by a transcendent Dark Star, followed by a flawless St Stephen into Not Fade Away and a soaring Turn On Your Lovelight, all delivered in an inspired, exploratory mode.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 reviews overwhelmingly praise both the performance (especially Dark Star and the set flow) and the matrix recording quality; only a few anomalous low‑star entries exist.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crisp, spacious and “beautiful,” noting that the matrix fixes earlier soundboard dropouts and provides a hall‑like ambience. No significant flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The night flows seamlessly from Dark Star into St Stephen, then a Not Fade Away sandwich with a hint of China Cat before launching into an ecstatic Turn On Your Lovelight; reviewers love the continuity despite occasional track‑split complaints.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers call his playing “angelic,” note his exploratory tone, Vox wah pedal work and flawless improvisation on Dark Star.
